treatment_summary: The patient is already on amlodipine 2.5 mg daily. To meet NICE NG136 step‑2 recommendation for uncontrolled hypertension, add ramipril 2.5 mg daily after obtaining baseline renal function, electrolytes and potassium. Monitor BP in 2 weeks, repeat labs at 2 weeks, then every 3–6 months. Continue non‑pharmacological measures (salt <6 g/day, DASH diet, exercise, weight management, limit alcohol, smoking cessation).
